Claim 5 (Currently Amended): Use of the composition of claim 1 for preparation of a blocking vaccine to __impede transmission of Leishmaniasis in humans__.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 4, wherein said composition further comprises suitable pharmacological vehicles, for blocking Leishmaniasis transmission __specifically in humans__.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 4 wherein the Leishmania promastigotes or Leishmania amastigotes fractions called "Fucose Mannose Ligand" (FML) comprise a glycoprotein complex containing __a specific composition that includes 29% neutral sugar, 44% protein, 11% phosphate, and trace amounts of hexosamines__ composed of protein bands with molecular weight ranging from 9 to 95 kDa, __with additional protein bands having carbohydrates: 36 and 54 to 68 kDa; the FML glycosidic portion's ratio of sugars including 10% fucose and 47% mannose, along with glucose at 30%, galactose at 12%, and xylose traces, as well as amino acids comprising 10 to 20% glutamic acid, alanine, aspartic acid, and glycine, along with lesser percentages of serine, histidine, lysine, leucine, threonine, proline, and valine, and 2 to 5% of arginine, methionine, isoleucine, tyrosine, and phenylalanine__.
